speech.heard: In Moldova, women are 54% of the population, in Qatar just 28.9%. Qatar is the world's lowest, counting all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship. Other Gulf nations sit near the bottom. Saudi Arabia has 39.6%, Kuwait 38.9%, Oman 37.6% and UAE 36.2%. Russia sits near the top, where women make up 53.6%. The two biggest superpowers both tilt male. USA has 49.8% and China has 49.1%. Where does your country land?
